---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible issue with one Open HVAC module
title: "[BUG] "
---

## Module and version

Which module and commit/release? Which Home Assistant Core version?

## Device

Manufacturer, exact model, firmware and communications interface.

## Expected and actual behavior

What should happen? What happened instead?

## Reproduction steps

List the minimal steps, starting with a read-only check where possible.

## Sanitized logs

Attach logs only after removing device IDs, local keys, credentials, tokens,
private IPs and customer/site information.

## Safety

Did any command modify live equipment? If yes, stop further write testing
until the cause is understood.
